project_info.color_palette: French Blue, Red, White, Sepia Stone, Sky Blue

main_subject.detail: A patriotic France-themed greeting poster with oversized text 'BONNE FÊTE NATIONALE FRANÇAISE', a July 2026 calendar card highlighting the 14th, torn-paper cityscape photo collage, and French tricolor blocks framing the layout.
main_subject.style: Travel-postcard editorial collage with patriotic brand design, vintage stamp motif, and clean celebratory typography.

composition_elements.text:
VFE VIETNAM FRANCE EXCHANGE
2026
THÁNG BẢY
14/07: Quốc khánh Pháp (Hay còn gọi là ngày Bastille)
BONNE FÊTE NATIONALE FRANÇAISE
Chúc mừng ngày Quốc khánh Pháp 14/07
items: Top Left: VFE logo block and a large Eiffel postal stamp illustration.
Top Right: July 2026 calendar card with the 14th highlighted and a French tricolor sticker.
Bottom Left: Torn-paper photo collage of a French classical building facade.
Bottom Right: White note card reading 'Chúc mừng ngày Quốc khánh Pháp 14/07' framed by blue and red corner blocks.
Center/Background: Large stacked navy headline 'BONNE FÊTE NATIONALE FRANÇAISE' on a cream grid-paper texture.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Crisp collage edges, clear patriotic contrast, and scrapbook-style paper texture.
